result.summary: Found several visual issues: a broken image placeholder in Popular right now, truncated restaurant names, and a missing/broken image area that leaves empty space.

issues.description: The main card under 'Popular right now' for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows only a broken-image placeholder icon instead of a restaurant photo, leaving a large empty gray area.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image or provide a proper fallback thumbnail so the card is not visually empty.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off at the end in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure horizontal cards give enough width for full names.

issues.description: The €0 delivery badge and heart icon sit on an empty gray block above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar title, making the card structure look incomplete and disconnected from the image below.
issues.suggestion: Bind the badge and favorite control to the actual image container and ensure the image loads so layout hierarchy is clear.
